svg.title: C8三方静态装载内容与调用输入对照
svg.desc: Original qualified fixture, same-source rebuild, and actual SDK linkage are compared statically. Each PT_LOAD memory range consists of 30024 file-backed bytes and 1416 zero-filled bytes, in exact horizontal proportion. All three 31440-byte BIN images are byte-identical. Forty-eight 64-byte call records are shown in original sequence, rows 8x32, 4x8, 16x64, 4x13, and dataset groups d0,d1,d2. Four records per dataset are not relabeled into a common method order: the first group retains its original special ordering. Twelve packed input arrays have sizes 288,40,1088,65 bytes in the same row order, three datasets each. Grid widths represent logical objects rather than physical byte sizes or addresses. Only the named debug sections differ outside allocated content; complete original ELF files are not identical. 627 counts protected files. This historical static qualification introduced zero EMU, NEMU or full-core runs and permits reuse of the original fixture evidence.
svg.text: 蓝区为文件内容；末端为 1,416 B 零填充
入口 0x80000000；地址、权限、对齐一致
